title: Surviving Girlhood by the Skin of Our Teeth

additional: Every chapter will be a stand alone and completed story

summary:
You could bribe her, you could threaten her, you could torture her until the brink of death and she still wouldn't ever call Pig 1 or Pig 2 'dad'. They're just a pair of freaks who decided it was in their best interest to put her through school and feed her.
If you bribe her just enough though, she will eventually admit that she likes Bino Pig slightly more.
(A collection of snapshots focusing on Cunoesse, the girl who never anticipated having normal problems like sleepovers and homework, and Kim, the man who never anticipated having to look after kids of his own.)
